assumptions.party: Four declared owned members; C0, native legal per-level equipment/phase/mid talents; one initial funded wallet and full HP per condition.
assumptions.actions: Native PLACE_ENTER/BOSS_ROUTE/COMBAT. No enemy stat, damage, heal, RNG or reward override. Native loss is a loss, not an audit failure.
assumptions.timing: Actual displayed2x schedule: presentationMs/1000 +3seconds per player combat input +6seconds settlement/reentry. Already-at-blossom fixture excludes acquisition/travel and final recovery. It is not a continuous hourly farming campaign.
assumptions.clock: Real action-start hour; each kind has one cross-region payout per hour, not two regional quotas.
assumptions.limits: One seed717 and two4starC0 compositions per matchup; no actual user-save or complete roster claim.
